blocks.text: As she turned a year older, Bea Alonzo opted for an intimate celebration in the company of her family and her husband, businessman Vincent Co. The actress bonded with her family and close friends over a meal at a Chinese restaurant, as seen in the video shared on Instagram by Pete Rich, one of Alonzo’s friends. The intimate gathering was held last Saturday, Oct. 17, as stated in the caption “101726.” Among those present were Alonzo’s mom Mary Anne, brother James and his wife, Thalia Agbayani. “Happy birthday, Bea!” Rich said.
